_about: Hand-written knowledge base for the VibeMatch retrieval step. Descriptions and genre relationships are simplified notes written for this class project, not an authoritative music taxonomy. Genres with in_catalog=false do not appear in data/songs.csv; they exist so the system can recognise them and fall back to related genres.

genres.name: pop
